description: Source code for the ReportingUploader class implementation, handling report uploads via network requests with preflight checks and response handling.

classes.name: ReportingUploaderImpl
classes.description: Implementation of ReportingUploader handling network requests, preflight checks, and response processing.

methods.name: StartUpload
methods.description: Initiates report upload, performing preflight or direct payload upload based on origin.

methods.name: StartPreflightRequest
methods.description: Starts a CORS preflight OPTIONS request.

methods.name: StartPayloadRequest
methods.description: Starts the actual report payload POST request.

methods.name: OnReceivedRedirect
methods.description: Handles HTTP redirects, cancels if non-cryptographic scheme.

methods.name: OnAuthRequired
methods.description: Cancels request if authentication is required.

methods.name: OnCertificateRequested
methods.description: Cancels request if client certificate is requested.

methods.name: OnResponseStarted
methods.description: Handles response, determines success or failure.

methods.name: HandlePreflightResponse
methods.description: Checks preflight response headers for CORS success.

methods.name: HandlePayloadResponse
methods.description: Processes payload response code to determine outcome.

methods.name: OnReadCompleted
methods.description: Should not be called; reporting does not read response body.

methods.name: GetPendingUploadCountForTesting
methods.description: Returns current count of pending uploads for testing.
